svg.title: Robot Motion Learning: HME, CP-SAT and DAgger
svg.desc: Left to right: robot motion sequences are encoded with HME and grouped with K-Means. Identical point clouds form a directed warm-start forest. The illustration uses roots C1 and C14; the actual number of roots depends on the solver output. Illustrative edges minimize Euclidean length for these roots; the actual CP-SAT solver also imposes scheduling constraints. Cluster teachers then supervise a unified student through DAgger. Points are schematic, not measured embeddings.

g.text: From Robot Motions to a Unified Control Policy
HME encoding & K-Means clustering / CP-SAT warm-start forest / Multi-teacher DAgger
Train along the forest → Cluster teachers
Warm start: parent teacher → child teacher
CP-SAT: minimize transfer cost under GPU capacity and precedence constraints.
Illustration: 14 clusters shown; project K = 96. Both plots use identical points.
Illustrative connections; the number of roots depends on the solver output.
